title: Lake Oswego Hunt Club
specs: Historic equestrian center with indoor and outdoor arenas, trails, and a 1/2 mile track
Ages 6 and up for summer camps
Must meet skill level for training camps; evaluation lesson may be required
Riders must be able to tack up, know leads, diagonals, and basic 2 point for jumper camps
Must be jumping minimum 12" (Beginner Jump Camp) or 18" (Intermediate Jump Camp) in weekly lessons
Eventing camp riders must be able to tack up, walk/trot/canter, have solid jump position and control horse in open field
includes: Instruction in grooming, tacking, handling, and mounted lessons
Use of cross-country vests available on loan with prior request
gap: Exact age minimum for training camps not stated
blurb: Guests participate in riding camps for various skill levels, from beginner to advanced training including jumping and eventing. Camps run Monday to Friday with options for early drop-off and late pickup. Facilities include indoor and outdoor arenas, trails, and boarding services.
extraNote: $275 non-refundable deposit due at registration for camps · Pick-ups after 4:00 pm incur $25 per 15 minutes fee
